title: Maven 依赖调解：最近优先，同层先声明优先
expected_output:
=== declared edges (root = app:1.0) ===
  app:1.0 -> lib-b:1.0
  app:1.0 -> lib-c:2.0
  lib-b:1.0 -> lib-c:1.0
  lib-b:1.0 -> lib-d:1.0
  lib-c:2.0 -> lib-d:2.0

=== resolved classpath (nearest wins; tie -> declared first) ===
  lib-b:1.0  depth=1
  lib-c:2.0  depth=1
  lib-d:1.0  depth=2

=== omitted from classpath ===
  lib-c:1.0  omitted for conflict with lib-c:2.0  [deeper (2 > 1)]
  lib-d:2.0  omitted for conflict with lib-d:1.0  [same depth, declared later]
